name: Textiles bistro set, 3-piece
material: steel frame w/t powder coated. w/t teslin fabric. bistro table w/t tempered glass
description: Enjoy casual dining indoors or outdoors with this 3-piece folding bistro set, including a tempered glass-top table and two ergonomic chairs. Built with a rust-resistant, UV-protected metal frame, it offers durability and long-lasting performance. The foldable design makes storage and transport easy, perfect for small patios, balconies, or gardens. Simple to clean and quick to assemble, this compact set is both practical and stylish.
